title: Low-Dimensional Adaptation of Rectified Flow: A Diffusion and Stochastic Localization Perspective
summary: In recent years, Rectified flow (RF) has gained considerable popularity largely due to its generation efficiency and state-of-the-art performance. In this paper, we investigate the degree to which RF automatically adapts to the intrinsic low dimensionality of the support of the target distribution to accelerate sampling.
